query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' AND street IS NOT NULL AND street != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_with_address,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' AND lat IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_geocoded,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' AND (street IS NULL OR street = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_no_address,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' AND street IS NOT NULL AND street != '' AND lat IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_has_address_not_geocoded
FROM pco_people;
